snippet.title: Aniimo 2nd Beta Sign Up Now | TGA 2025 Special Trailer | Let the next beta start!
snippet.description:
Sign up for a chance to get access for the Closed Beta Test 2 on our official website! 👉 https://bit.ly/Aniimo_Website
Add Aniimo to your Steam wishlist! 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4126040/Aniimo/

Pathfinders, new Aniimo have been spotted all over Idyll! Are you ready to embark on a journey to discover them all?

Immerse yourself once again, alone or with friends, in this dynamic, interactive, and expansive world to uncover all its hidden secrets!

Some of the new features added in Closed Beta 2:
- More new areas to explore
- More new Aniimo waiting to be discovered
- More new gameplay offering unlimited ways to play

And Follow us on social media!
X: https://twitter.com/Aniimo_EN
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@aniimo_na 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aniimo_en/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AniimoGL/
And join our Discord: https://discord.gg/aniimo

#Aniimo #BeOneBeAll #AniimoBetaTest2 #TheGameAwards
